dlnmLPS

dlnmLPS is an R package for fitting distributed lag non-linear models within a Bayesian framework using Laplacian-P-Splines. It provides a flexible approach for modelling complex exposure-lag-response relationships, including relationships that vary spatially or according to pre-specified continuous or categorical modifiers, as well as exposure-lag-response relationships for two joint exposures. In addition to exposure-lag-response relationships, dlnmLPS allows other sources of heterogeneity to be incorporated, including smooth covariate effects, random effects and spatial and temporal structures.

More specifically, dlnmLPS can be used to model:

  • distributed lag non-linear associations, allowing non-linear exposure-response relationships over multiple time lags. DLNMs can be unpenalized (natural splines or B-splines) or penalized (P-splines);

  • random effects, including independent random effects and spatially structured random effects (ICAR, BYM or Leroux). These random effects can possibly vary over time (according to an independent or random walk structure);

  • temporal random effects, including first- and second-order random-walk structures. These temporal effects can possibly depend on location (according to an independent, ICAR or Leroux structure);

  • smooth exposure effects, using natural splines (ns), B-splines (bs), or P-splines (ps); and

  • more complex DLNM extensions, including effect modification, spatially varying DLNMs, and models with bivariate exposures.

The different components can be combined to construct models that account simultaneously for non-linear exposure-response relationships, distributed lag effects, and spatial or temporal dependence. Supported outcome distributions are Poisson, negative binomial, binomial and Gaussian.

Documentation

Detailed documentation for dlnmLPS is available through the tabs on this website:

  • The Reference tab provides an overview of the functions available in dlnmLPS, including their arguments and return values.

  • The Articles tab provides more detailed explanations of the package functionality, with examples illustrating how to specify and fit different models.

Installation

The development version of dlnmLPS can be installed from the GitHub repository using:

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("Rutten-Sara/dlnmLPS")

To install dlnmLPS together with its vignettes, containing short tutorials, use:

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("Rutten-Sara/dlnmLPS", build_vignettes = TRUE)

Afterwards, the vignettes can be requested using:

browseVignettes("dlnmLPS")

Package version

This is version 0.1.0 (2026-09-01).

dlnmLPS is currently under active development. This is an early development version, and the package interface may change as functionality is developed and tested.
